control_name: Backups succeed and restores are periodically tested
control_objective: Backups of financially-significant systems succeed on schedule and restores are periodically tested, so that financial data can be recovered intact in the event of loss or corruption.
risk_addressed: Failed backups or untested restores can leave financially-significant data unrecoverable after a loss or corruption event, threatening the integrity and availability of financial records and the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The completion status of an in-scope backup job in the period.
The documented result of a restore test performed during the cycle.

method.summary: Confirm all in-scope backups succeeded in the period and that at least one restore test was performed and documented this cycle.
steps: Pull all in-scope backup job results for the period from the backup logs.
Compute the backup success rate across the in-scope population.
Confirm a documented restore test was performed during the cycle.
Flag any backup failure and any cycle without a restore test.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any in-scope backup failure or absence of a restore test in the cycle is a control exception.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 100% backup success and 1 restore test performed
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Any backup failure or no restore test in the cycle

pass_criteria: A restore test was performed and documented this cycle.
fail_criteria: One or more in-scope backups failed.
No restore test was performed this cycle.
exception_handling: Re-run failed backups and confirm success.
Schedule and document a restore test.
Open a SOX deficiency issue if a backup failed or no restore test was performed.

assertions.description: A restore test was performed this cycle.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Operations Manager and CISO
